content:
incident-bot: ALERT: Sustained RPM surge for model-family titania-9b in us-west-2. Error rate up 4.8% and p95 latency spike. Paging on-call.
emma: I’m on it, grabbing logs and trace links.
raj: any obvious customer causing spike? quick check of top tenants.
mitra: looking at routing—we're seeing a big increase from a small set of clients hitting generate+func_call heavy flows.
luca: FYI we've got two related 5xx error classes: kvcache OOM + timeout to backend tokenizer.
emma: can we quick-sculpt per-model rates? prefer reduce RPM first, keep TPM until we see token-level issues.
raj: +1 reduce RPM by 50% for titania-9b family. also disable func_call for that family as temporary mitigation.
mitra: executing policy change now. running admin API:

```
POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/quota/update
{
  "model_family": "titania-9b",
  "changes": {"rpm": "-50%", "func_call": "disable"},
  "reason": "live mitigation - KV OOM + tokenization latency",
  "who": "mitra"
}
```

ops-bot: action accepted, change queued on gateway pool 4. Rolling update in 30s.
emma: triggering canary on 2 nodes first.
selena: heads-up to CS: prepping a note for affected customers, should we proactively message high-volume tenants? (I can draft)
raj: yes draft now — include that we're throttling model family to stabilize and that API keys will see slower throughput but fewer errors.
mitra: canary succeeded on nodes 12/13. initiating wider roll.
ops-bot: rollout completed at 4800123601. Config applied across us-west-2.
luca: metrics: RPM down 52%, 5xx dropped from 4.8% -> 0.9% p95 latency back to baseline. Good.
emma: re-enabled function_call for a small subset to validate -- still stable. we should keep func_call disabled for public traffic for 30m.
raj: agreed. Mitigation summary: RPM -50% across titania-9b, func_call disabled for general pool, canary validated, CS notified draft in flight.
selena: sending message to top 5 tenants now, linking to status.redwood.ai/incidents/4800123456
mitra: follow-up tasks: investigate root cause of KV OOM (maybe sequence-length explosion) and tokenizer latency; open follow-up incident and assign to eng-runtime.
emma: assigning to @raj and @luca for postmortem. I'll handoff to next on-call in 20m.
raj: taking handoff notes. If we see another spike, escalate to scale-down model variant and re-route to dedicated infra.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by on-call. Tags: mitigation=quota-sculpt, impact=customer-throttle, model_family=titania-9b, status=stabilized.
emma: thanks team :thumbsup: I’ll update the incident doc and close this thread after postmortem link created.
